items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...We've mentioned Louis Bacon... [INTERVIEWEE] Uh-huh, and, yeah, I should have mentioned Freddie Jenkins.

ctx.x: But Louis is the only -- Charlie Gaines himself, I knew him. He was a trumpet player and I knew Louis. I didn't know the rest of the guys too well. But Louis Jordan, he left there to go to Chick Webb.

Uh-huh. You got any more trumpet players on your list that you could probably -- guys that really contributed. We've mentioned Louis Bacon, we've mentioned Starks, we've mentioned the Smiths, we've mentioned --
Uh-huh, and, yeah, I should have mentioned Freddie Jenkins.
